description_en: Queries the virtual MFA devices bound to AD accounts
description_zh: 查询AD账号绑定的虚拟MFA设备
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-virtual-mfa-devices --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 100 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-2693450000 --end-user-id testuser --filter 0jin0 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVirtualMFADevices

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果的最大数量。取值范围：1~500。默认值：100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken that was returned from the last call to this operation
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证。取值为上一次调用此API时返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The list of AD account usernames
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The fuzzy match query string character
parameters.name: filter
